name: The Hours Before Christmas
source:
In this game, you pick two people to accompany as they prepare for their Christmas celebration! Choose any duo from the five-person cast and listen in on their conversations to glean information on the world around you. 

What is being hidden from you? And what answers can you gain just by asking? 

[From [url=https://thereseu3u.itch.io/the-hours-before-christmas-demo]itch.io[/url]]
